senses.gloss: m. (denom. of התעמר, Deut. XXIV, 7, v. עָמַר) using as a slave, deriving benefit from a stolen person, service.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 11:1">ib. XI, 1</cite>) <he>ותנא קמא לא בעי ע׳</he> does the first named authority not require that, in order to be guilty, the kidnapper must have imposed a slave’s service upon the stolen person? <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 11:1">Ib.</cite> <he>יש דרך ע׳ בכך וכ׳</he> is this a sort of service or not? <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 11:1">Ib.</cite> <he>ותיפוק ליה ליכא ע׳ כלל</he> but this would be no service at all.
